info.title: Bigfoot API
info.description:
Bigfoot's data API: a job seeker's Applications and their Interviews, in Supabase Postgres.

Every route but `/health` and a Share link's status and Passcode check needs
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and reads and writes only the data of the job seeker the token
names. There are two kinds of token that name a job seeker:

- **Access token** (`AccessToken`): a secret starting with `bigfoot_` that a job seeker creates on
  their Account page and gives a script, such as a cron job. It works on the Applications and
  Interviews routes, expires after a year, and can be revoked
  ([ADR 0003](https://github.com/wisamjs/bigfoot/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-access-tokens-open-fastapi-to-scripts.md)).
- **Web token** (`WebToken`): a short-lived JWT the Next.js server signs for the signed-in job
  seeker. The browser itself never calls this API. Web tokens work on every route, and are the only
  way to use the Account, Access tokens, and Share links routes
  ([ADR 0001](https://github.com/wisamjs/bigfoot/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-fastapi-behind-nextjs-with-authjs.md)).

A third kind, the **Viewer token** (`ViewerToken`), names a Share link instead: a Viewer gets one by
typing the link's Passcode, and it reads only that link's Journey
([ADR 0008](https://github.com/wisamjs/bigfoot/blob/main/docs/adr/0008-a-share-link-lets-a-viewer-read-a-journey.md)).

Terms such as Application, Interview, Waiting, Sample Application, and Access token are defined in
[GLOSSARY.md](https://github.com/wisamjs/bigfoot/blob/main/GLOSSARY.md).

To try a request, click **Authorize** and paste an Access token from the Account page, or a web
token from `node scripts/dev-api-token.mjs`.

get.description: Always `ok` while the API is serving. Doesn't touch the database.

post.description:
Record the job seeker, and give them Sample Applications the first time only.

Idempotent, and safe to call concurrently: the insert waits on any other transaction
inserting the same job seeker, and `for update` serializes the seeding check.

delete.description:
Delete the job seeker, all of their Applications (with their Interviews and Participants), Access tokens and
Share links, in one transaction.

Idempotent: deleting an account that is already gone succeeds and logs nothing. Signing
in again afterwards makes a new job seeker, who receives Sample Applications again.

post.summary: Open a Share link with its Passcode
post.description:
Check the Passcode and return a Viewer token for this Share link, valid until it expires.

A wrong Passcode is counted; the 5th within 15 minutes locks the link, and while it is locked
even the right Passcode is refused. Tries on one link take turns, so the count is exact.

get.description:
The job seeker's Journey: their In Progress Applications and Offers, with each one's company,
role, applied date, and Interviews (category, title, and time). Of the other Done Applications,
only when their completed Interviews happened, for the count of Interviews completed this month.
Salary, job postings, Location, Prep notes, Interview notes, and Outcome notes are never read.

Every request checks the link again, so stopping it, letting it expire, or changing its Passcode
cuts the Viewer off at once. Records when the link was last opened, to within a minute.

post.description:
Add an Application for the job seeker. It starts In Progress with no Interviews unless the body
says otherwise; a Done Application needs an Outcome, and its Done date is today unless one is sent. The
number of Applications is capped (409).

401.description: The bearer token is missing, expired, or invalid.

409.description: The job seeker already has 1,000 Applications, the most Bigfoot keeps.

patch.description:
Change some of an Application's fields and return it with its Interviews.

Only the fields sent change. Setting the status to `in_progress` reopens the Application and clears
its Outcome, Done date, and Outcome note; setting it to `done` needs an Outcome, sent now or already
set, and from `in_progress` sets the Done date to today unless one is sent. Setting the location to
anything but `hybrid` clears its office days.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, expired, or invalid.

404.description: No Application with this id belongs to the job seeker.

422.description: The body is invalid (a list of field errors), or the change would leave a Done Application without an Outcome, an In Progress one with an Outcome, a Done date, or an Outcome note, a Done date before the applied date, or office days on a Location that isn't Hybrid (a message).

post.description:
Add an Interview to an Application. The category, title, `at`, and at least one Participant are
required; `at: null` adds an Unscheduled Interview (docs/adr/0009), which a Done Application refuses (422).
Categories and titles can repeat, and Interview notes and Prep notes are optional. A Participant sent by
`id` must be one of the Application's (422). The number of Interviews per Application is capped (409).

401.description: The bearer token is missing, expired, or invalid.

404.description: No Application with this id belongs to the job seeker.

409.description: The Application already has 50 Interviews, the most it can have.

patch.description:
Change an Interview's category, title, date, Interview notes, Prep notes, or Participants.

Only the fields sent change; send null for `what_they_asked`, `how_it_went`, `takeaway` or `prep_notes` to
clear it. The category and title can't be cleared. `at: null` makes the Interview Unscheduled, on an In
Progress Application only (422 on a Done one). `participants` replaces the Interview's
Participants: at least one, and a Participant left in no Interview is deleted. An `id` that isn't one of
the Application's Participants is refused (422).

so they can check what a Viewer sees without a Passcode, before making a link or after. It
records no Share link as opened. `shared_by` is null: Bigfoot stores the name only on a link.

ApplicationPatch.title: ApplicationPatch
ApplicationPatch.description:
Only the fields sent are changed; send null to clear an optional field.

Setting the status to in_progress without an outcome clears the outcome, Done date, and Outcome note
(reopening); setting it to done from in_progress without a done_on sets the Done date to today. Setting the
location to anything but hybrid without office_days clears the office days.

JourneyApplication.description: An In Progress Application or an Offer as a Viewer sees it: no salary, job posting, Location, or notes.

category.title: Category
category.description: What the Interview assesses (GLOSSARY.md, Interview category, docs/adr/0007): recruiter, hiring_manager, technical, system_design, project_deep_dive, people_management, project_delivery, collaboration, culture, or decision_maker.

title.title: Title
title.description: The Interview's name in the job seeker's own words (GLOSSARY.md, Interview title), at most 200 characters. Required; the ends are trimmed.

at.title: At
at.description: When the Interview happens: a date and time, with a time zone. Null when the Interview is Unscheduled (GLOSSARY.md, docs/adr/0009): upcoming, with no date and time yet, shown as "Date TBD".

completed.title: Completed
completed.description: Derived, never stored: the date is in the past. An Unscheduled Interview is never completed.

JourneyInterview.title: JourneyInterview
JourneyInterview.description: An Interview as a Viewer sees it: what it is and when, never its notes.

name.title: Name
name.description: What the job seeker called the token.

last_used_at.title: Last Used At
last_used_at.description: When a request last used the token, to within a minute; null until one does.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the token stops working: a year after it was created.

expired.title: Expired
expired.description: Derived, never stored: `expires_at` has passed, so the token no longer works.

token.title: Token
token.description: The secret to send as `Authorization: Bearer …`. Shown only in this response.

NewAccessToken.title: NewAccessToken
NewAccessToken.description: An Access token as returned once, when it is created.

label.title: Label
label.description: Who the link is for, as the job seeker wrote it.

passcode_set_at.title: Passcode Set At
passcode_set_at.description: When the Passcode was last set: at creation, or by Change passcode.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the link stops working: 7 days after it was created or last renewed.

last_opened_at.title: Last Opened At
last_opened_at.description: When a Viewer last opened the link; null until one does.

expired.title: Expired
expired.description: Derived, never stored: `expires_at` has passed, so the link no longer opens.

passcode.title: Passcode
passcode.description: The Passcode, shown only in this response.

NewShareLink.title: NewShareLink
NewShareLink.description: A Share link as returned when it is created or its Passcode changes: the one time the Passcode is shown.

samples_seeded.title: Samples Seeded
samples_seeded.description: Whether this call gave the job seeker Sample Applications. True the first time only.

role.title: Role
role.description: What the Participant does at the company, in the job seeker's words, at most 200 characters. Required; the ends are trimmed.

name.title: Name
name.description: The Participant's name, at most 200 characters. Optional: null when the job seeker knows only the role.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description:
Someone from the company whom the job seeker meets (GLOSSARY.md). Belongs to one Application and can be
in several of its Interviews.

id.title: Id
id.description: A Participant already on this Application. Omit for someone new. Their role and name become those sent, on every Interview they are in.

role.title: Role
role.description: What the Participant does at the company, in the job seeker's words, at most 200 characters. Required; the ends are trimmed.

name.title: Name
name.description: The Participant's name, at most 200 characters. Optional: null when the job seeker knows only the role. Blank is stored as null.

ParticipantInput.title: ParticipantInput
ParticipantInput.description: A Participant as an Interview sends them: one already on the Application, by `id`, or someone new.

PasscodeAttempt.title: PasscodeAttempt
PasscodeAttempt.description: What a Viewer typed to open a Share link.

passcode.title: Passcode
passcode.description: The Passcode (GLOSSARY.md) a Viewer types to open the Share link: 8 to 128 characters, kept exactly as sent. Bigfoot stores only an argon2id hash of it.

label.title: Label
label.description: Who the link is for, as the job seeker wrote it.

passcode_set_at.title: Passcode Set At
passcode_set_at.description: When the Passcode was last set: at creation, or by Change passcode.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the link stops working: 7 days after it was created or last renewed.

last_opened_at.title: Last Opened At
last_opened_at.description: When a Viewer last opened the link; null until one does.

expired.title: Expired
expired.description: Derived, never stored: `expires_at` has passed, so the link no longer opens.

ShareLink.title: ShareLink
ShareLink.description:
A private link a job seeker makes so a Viewer can follow their search (GLOSSARY.md). Never
includes the Passcode: Bigfoot stores only its hash.

label.title: Label
label.description: Who the link is for, so the job seeker can tell their links apart. Only they see it.

passcode.title: Passcode
passcode.description: The Passcode (GLOSSARY.md) a Viewer types to open the Share link: 8 to 128 characters, kept exactly as sent. Bigfoot stores only an argon2id hash of it.

shared_by.title: Shared By
shared_by.description: The job seeker's name as their Viewers see it: "Shared by Wisam Zaghal".

ShareLinkCreate.title: ShareLinkCreate
ShareLinkCreate.description: A new Share link: who it's for and its Passcode. It always expires 7 days after it is created.

shared_by.title: Shared By
shared_by.description: The job seeker's name as their Viewers see it; null for a link made before Bigfoot stored it.

expired.title: Expired
expired.description: The link has expired: it opens again only once the job seeker renews it.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: 5 wrong Passcodes were typed in the last 15 minutes, so none is accepted until they age out.

ShareLinkStatus.title: ShareLinkStatus
ShareLinkStatus.description:
What a Share link's Passcode page needs, before the Passcode is typed. Nothing else about the
job seeker: the link id alone opens no more than this.

token.title: Token
token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer …` to read the Journey.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the token stops working: when the Share link expires.

ViewerToken.title: ViewerToken
ViewerToken.description: A Viewer's credential for one Share link, returned when the Passcode is right (docs/adr/0008).

WebToken.description: A short-lived HS256 JWT signed with API_SECRET, with `sub` set to the job seeker's id, `aud` 'bigfoot-api' and `iss` 'bigfoot-web'. The Next.js server signs one per request for the signed-in job seeker; locally, `node scripts/dev-api-token.mjs` prints one for the test job seeker.

ViewerToken.description: A Viewer token: an HS256 JWT this API returns when a Viewer types a Share link's Passcode. It reads that Share link's Journey only, and stops working when the link is stopped, expires, or gets a new Passcode. The Next.js server keeps it in the Viewer's cookie for that link.

AccessToken.description: An Access token: a secret starting with `bigfoot_` that a job seeker creates on their Account page and gives a script. It reads and writes that job seeker's Applications and Interviews, expires a year after it is created, and stops working when revoked. It can't reach the Account routes.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The signed-in job seeker: onboarding, exporting, and deleting the account. Web tokens only.

tags.name: Access tokens
tags.description: Secrets that let a job seeker's scripts use the API as them. Web tokens only.

tags.name: Share links
tags.description: Private links that let a Viewer follow the job seeker's search, each with its own Passcode. Web tokens only.

tags.name: Journey
tags.description: A Viewer's side of a Share link: its status and Passcode check need no token; the Journey needs the Viewer token the Passcode check returns.

tags.name: Applications
tags.description: Roles the job seeker has applied to, each with its Interviews.

tags.name: Interviews
tags.description: Conversations in a company's hiring process, one Application each.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Whether the API is up. Needs no token.
